findings.current: At Mu Song’s nod, his subordinates approached and dragged the river bandits away.
findings.defect: The draft changes Mu Song’s chin gesture into a nod, altering the specified physical action.
findings.rationale: 턱짓 is a gesture made with the chin, not a nod.
findings.replacement: At a jerk of Mu Song’s chin, his subordinates approached and dragged the river bandits away.
findings.source: 무송이 턱짓하자 그의 수하들이 다가와 수적들을 질질 끌고 갔다.

findings.current: Unlike the other river bandits, a man in his fifties knelt before Mu Song with his body tightly bound in chains.
findings.defect: The draft loses the causative force of 무릎 꿇려진 and makes the prisoner appear to kneel rather than having been forced to his knees.
findings.rationale: 무릎 꿇려진 explicitly describes a posture imposed on Hwang Tae-gu by others.
findings.replacement: Unlike the other river bandits, a man in his fifties had been forced to his knees before Mu Song, tightly bound in chains.
findings.source: 다른 수적들과는 달리 쇠사슬에 꽁꽁 묶인 채 무송의 앞에 무릎 꿇려진 오십 대의 사내.

findings.current: Yes. I can still vividly see the way you boldly—no, courageously—pierced straight through the ship.
findings.defect: “Boldly” does not preserve Mujin’s slip into calling the act reckless before hastily correcting himself.
findings.rationale: 무모 means reckless; the self-correction to 용맹하게 is the joke and reflects Mujin’s fear of Taekyung’s reaction.
findings.replacement: Yes. I can still vividly see the way you recklessly—no, courageously—pierced straight through the ship.
findings.source: 예. 무모, 아니 용맹하게 선박을 그대로 관통해 버리시던 모습이 지금도 눈에 훤합니다.

findings.current: *If this is how he grew, then… it’s better than nothing.*
findings.defect: “Better than nothing” dismisses Cheongpung’s growth as inadequate, whereas Taekyung concludes that growth achieved even through these painful circumstances may be fortunate or for the best.
findings.rationale: 차라리 다행이지 expresses qualified relief about the outcome, not dissatisfaction with the amount or quality of Cheongpung’s growth.
findings.replacement: *If he managed to grow even this way… maybe it was for the best.*

findings.current: Powerful energy gathered at the tips of both weapons.
findings.defect: The generic “energy” fails to render Murim 기운 as qi under the binding terminology distinction.
findings.rationale: This is martial energy gathered on a harpoon and spear immediately before the release of Spear Energy, so 기운 denotes Murim qi.
findings.replacement: Powerful qi gathered at the tips of both weapons.
findings.source: 바로 그 끝에 맺힌 강대한 기운.

findings.current: The distance was easily over two hundred zhang. But my vision had improved enough to be called eagle-eyed, allowing me to take in the entire scene at a glance.
findings.defect: “Eagle-eyed” normalizes away the narrator’s deliberately exaggerated image of himself as a literal “human eagle.”
findings.rationale: 인간 독수리 is “human eagle,” and preserving that odd image retains Taekyung’s comic narrative voice.
findings.replacement: The distance was easily over two hundred zhang. But my vision had improved enough that you could call me a human eagle, allowing me to take in the entire scene at a glance.
findings.source: 족히 이백여 장은 떨어진 거리. 그러나 인간 독수리라고 불러도 될 만큼 향상된 시력은 모든 광경을 일목요연하게 담아냈다.

findings.current: There’ll be a mass funeral today. Tsk, tsk.
findings.defect: A “mass funeral” is one ceremony for multiple dead people, while 줄초상 predicts a succession of deaths and funerals.
findings.rationale: 줄초상 refers to multiple deaths or funerals occurring in succession, matching Gung Gibang’s prediction that the bandits will be killed one after another.
findings.replacement: There’ll be funerals one after another today. Tsk, tsk.

summary: One altered physical action, one loss of coercive agency, and several characterization, humor, and terminology issues require correction.
